changes.problem: m2_stage2k1r3_closeout.py mixed capsule/validator/confidence/shadow/sensitivity business logic into a thick CLI.
changes.old: All business logic (build_capsule, validate_capsule, capsule_digest, score_input_id_for, build_confidence, build_shadow, build_sensitivity, _make_score_input, _resolve_records) defined in m2_stage2k1r3_closeout.py.
changes.new: Business logic moved to ashare_research.scoring.{capsule,validator,confidence,shadow,sensitivity}; m2_stage2k1r3_closeout.py is a thin CLI (~170 lines) that only parses args, dispatches, writes output, and enforces exit codes.

changes.problem: validate or verify-artifacts failure could still return exit 0.
changes.old: CLI main() returned 0 unconditionally; command failures never propagated a non-zero exit code.
changes.new: Exit codes: 0 success (build/resolve/validate pass/verify pass); 1 validate or verify-artifacts FAILED; 2 contract/parameter/internal error; 3 external cache required but missing.

changes.problem: The validator recomputed from upstream but did not require the capsule's resolved_records audit snapshot to match upstream.
changes.old: validate_capsule recomputed value/source_tier/score_input_id from upstream but ignored the capsule's resolved_records snapshot; a tampered snapshot with a correct score_input_id passed.
changes.new: validate_capsule now compares the capsule's resolved_records snapshot against the authoritative recomputed record set and reports capsule_snapshot_mismatch on any difference. Reports authoritative_recomputation_status, audit_snapshot_status, snapshot_errors, snapshot_warning_count.
changes.evidence: tests/test_m2_stage2k1r4a_engineering_closeout.py::test_validator_* (audit snapshot); old R3 test test_validator_ignores_capsule_record_snapshot replaced by test_validator_rejects_audit_snapshot_mismatch

changes.problem: Risk status output 'clear' when there was no trigger but still missing evidence.
changes.old: _risk_status returned 'clear' when veto_n == 0 even when missing_evidence_slots > 0.
changes.new: Finite enum (no 'clear'): blocked_by_risk_veto, no_trigger_observed_with_missing_evidence, no_trigger_observed_within_bounded_evidence, not_trusted. complete_absence_claim always False. PetroChina: no_trigger_observed_with_missing_evidence.

changes.problem: Sensitivity v4 lost the coverage/confidence/transform/missing-ROIC scenarios present in v3.
changes.old: sensitivity v4 only ran weight perturbation and leave-one-component-out (2 scenario classes).
changes.new: sensitivity v5 restores all 6 scenario classes from the v3 baseline: weight perturbation, leave-one-component-out, coverage-threshold perturbation, frozen transform alternatives, confidence-threshold perturbation (evaluated, never mutates coverage gate), missing-ROIC scenarios. Coverage and confidence gates remain independent.
